descriptions.w3d_collect_crate_copy_80017e28: Copy-constructs the 52-byte CollectCrate plan in external storage: constructs the native cost base at0x80006360, initializes the intermediate path-plan defaults including its owned path pointer at+32, installs derived table0x8040d958 and performs the original memberwise copy while preserving that table. The intermediate path-owner relationship is witnessed by destructors0x803428dc and0x80017304.
